title: Franchise Mix of All: Master Index Overview
body:
This public edition is the master index of all twelve franchise pairs in this lane, plus the crossover pair. It lists every pair's slugs, record counts and governing specification, and it gives the public reading and viewing order for each franchise.

The pairs are: Harry Potter (harry-potter-franchise / harry-potter-franchise-signature); Star Wars (star-wars-franchise / star-wars-franchise-signature); Star Trek (star-trek-franchise / star-trek-franchise-signature); The Lord of the Rings (lord-of-the-rings-franchise / lord-of-the-rings-franchise-signature); Marvel (marvel-franchise / marvel-franchise-signature); DC (dc-franchise / dc-franchise-signature); Pokémon (pokemon-franchise / pokemon-franchise-signature); Super Mario (super-mario-franchise / super-mario-franchise-signature); Minecraft (minecraft-franchise / minecraft-franchise-signature); The Witcher (witcher-franchise / witcher-franchise-signature); Doctor Who (doctor-who-franchise / doctor-who-franchise-signature); Sherlock Holmes (sherlock-holmes-franchise / sherlock-holmes-franchise-signature); plus franchise-crossovers / franchise-crossovers-signature.

No copyrighted text is reproduced in this index. Each entry points at its own database, where the full records live.

print("Franchise Mix of All | master index")
print("Franchise pairs indexed: 12")
print("Plus crossover pair: 1")

title: Franchise Mix of All: Reading and Viewing Order Guide
body:
Across the lane, the standing rule for public order is publication and release order within each franchise, as recorded in each franchise's own order guide. Cross-franchise reading has no official order, and this guide does not invent one.

Use this master index to pick a franchise, follow its own order guide, and then, if desired, read its Signature continuations, which are labeled unofficial and stand outside official order.

The crossover pair has its own pairing order: the eleven pairings are listed in the crossover database in the order given there.
